Name the Reckoning

You point your weapon at your quarry, speak the promise that brought you here, and strike as you step into their path.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Tell them why you came as you make a melee attack. Your certainty, not your strength, guides the strike.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 3 physical damage; mark it as your quarry until the end of your next turn. - Strong: 5 physical damage; mark it and move 1 square toward it without provoking.

Duration: Damage and movement are immediate; the quarry mark lasts until the end of your next turn.

Equipment / acquisition: Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Influence 1

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
